FAQ.title: الأسئلة الشائعة
FAQ.subtitle: إجابات لأسئلتك.
FAQ.partnerPitchBody: حوّل المساحة الفارغة إلى دخل — تعرّف على التطبيق والعمولات.
FAQ.a1: Yes. Partner shops follow platform rules; bags are sealed and photographed at drop-off. Protection up to 5,000 TL per bag applies under the conditions described in our Terms — it complements shop operations and is not a standalone retail policy.
FAQ.q2: How do refunds work if I cancel?
FAQ.a2: If you cancel at least 24 hours before check-in, you get a full refund to your card. If between 1 and 24 hours remain before check-in, 50% is refunded to your card. Less than 1 hour before check-in, or after check-in time, there is no card refund — you receive a one-time discount code for the amount paid. If you have not completed payment yet, you can cancel the request anytime at no charge.
FAQ.a3: Pay online with major credit and debit cards through our secure provider (iyzico). Cash is not accepted. Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal can be enabled via Stripe when we activate that gateway — we will announce it on the site.
FAQ.q4: What if the shop is closed or I need help?
FAQ.a4: Contact us via the contact page or WhatsApp. We will help you reschedule, find another nearby storage point, or resolve issues with your booking.
FAQ.q5: What does the insurance line on checkout cover?
FAQ.a5: The insurance fee on checkout contributes to the protection package described in our Terms (up to 5,000 TL per bag when conditions are met). Exact scope, exclusions and claims are set out in the Terms and related notices — read them before you book.
FAQ.a6: You send a request with your dates and bag sizes. The shop reviews and approves. You then complete payment if required and receive a QR code to show at drop-off. This is a request flow — instant confirmation may vary by shop.
FAQ.a7: Yes. We use S, M and XL slots with different daily rates. Choose the size that matches your luggage. Oversized or unusual items may need partner approval — ask support before booking.
FAQ.a8: No. Only online card payments (and future wallet options) are accepted. This keeps a clear payment trail and aligns with platform protection rules.
